name: How much does it cost to fix a sewage smell in the bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a sewage smell in the bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a sewage smell varies depending on the underlying cause. Simple fixes, like refilling a dry P-trap, may have no cost. More complex issues, such as repairing a cracked vent pipe or replacing a toilet's wax ring, will incur labor and material charges. We provide transparent pricing after diagnosing the problem. We service areas including Goodyear, Buckeye, and Avondale.
